⚡ TAWG Daily Catch-up — 2026-08-24 23:00 UTC → 2026-08-25 23:00 UTC

🤝 What moved

**ERC-8309**
Implementation across the mesh store, attestation layer, and conformance suite advanced in parallel, with a key encoding dependency cleared before end of day.
• Merlini opened PR #3 on ccip-router to address how the mesh store handles divergent observations from multiple independent vantage points, filling a gap where independent observations were being collapsed too early and ensuring ERC-8309 correctness across concurrent sources. [PR #3](https://github.com/trustless-ai/ccip-router/pull/3)
• Merlini followed with stacked PR #4 on ccip-router adding signature-indexed attestation storage and closing a previously deferred design item, so the router now holds the attestation material that downstream verification steps require. [PR #4](https://github.com/trustless-ai/ccip-router/pull/4)
• Merlini opened PR #20 on recompute-kit introducing a versioned conformance suite for the ERC-8309 resolution-envelope specification in §5, backed by hash-pinned test contracts, giving the group a concrete test baseline against the spec. [PR #20](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/20)
• Baby Blue Viper performed a cold-clone and applied five independent verification methods before filing their review of PR #20, strengthening the group's confidence in the conformance suite without relying on the author's local environment. [review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/20#pullrequestreview-5020238386)
• Merlini self-corrected on PR #20, clarifying that an earlier note had incorrectly implied the change would turn CI green — having checked the actual run output, the correction keeps the group's understanding of the PR's scope accurate. [comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/20#issuecomment-5412150198)
• Pavlo opened PR #21 introducing a versioned encoding contract that standardizes UTF-8 line-ending handling in recompute-kit, directly supplying the encoding baseline that the PR #20 conformance suite depends on. [PR #21](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/21)
• Pavlo reported that PR #21 has landed on canonical main, clearing the encoding-contract dependency that had kept PR #20 from being fully discharged and moving the conformance work clearly closer to merge. [tg:tawg:3361]

**attribution-ledger**
A new attribution schema proposal iterated through two revisions and a live design review all within a single day.
• Baby Blue Viper shared a first-draft attribution ledger schema defining fields for claim, actor, verified_by, timestamp, surface, type, and evidence, together with four reference examples, opening a concrete design space for the group to reason about how contributions are recorded. [tg:tawg:3347]
• Baby Blue Viper published v2 the same day, addressing six feedback points and replacing informal verified_application handling with proper JSON Schema validation, making the proposal machine-checkable and internally consistent. [tg:tawg:3356]
• Merlini read the v2 proposal files directly and flagged a concern about how the surface taxonomy was specified, wanting to resolve it before the design was finalized — giving the proposal a chance to converge on cleaner vocabulary while it is still open. [tg:tawg:3362]
• Baby Blue Viper responded promptly with the agreed change, updating the surface classification taxonomy to commons/commercial_product/external and aligning the proposal's vocabulary with the group's shared conventions. [tg:tawg:3365]

**ERC-8004**
Discussion of slashing testability requirements is progressing.
• sen_vouch argued that a slashable outcome must be verifiable by any independent party after it occurs, contributing a testability constraint that sharpens what the spec must guarantee for accountability to function correctly. [post #380](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/380)

**organization**
The daily template and knowledge infrastructure both received targeted improvements.
• Jimmy Shi landed a format commit applying per-direction synthesis sentences, plain bullet style, and section-emoji placement restricted to the Next up heading, keeping the daily template aligned with the output contract so future catch-ups generate correctly. [commit 3b747b1](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/commit/3b747b10a75eccbd15bcec2c3e09e8ce1f1a1277)
• The knowledge bot checkpointed a deferred ERC-8183 knowledge item, preserving coverage continuity so the group can rely on the knowledge base for ERC-8183 questions without a gap. [commit d29988c](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/commit/d29988c2a1c5bd534a2518292c2308efe790cac8)

🚀 Next up

💡 ideas to follow
• The surface taxonomy in the attribution ledger may benefit from a short definition document so implementors apply commons/commercial_product/external consistently across surfaces.
• The ERC-8004 post-hoc checkability constraint could inform how the ERC-8309 resolution envelope exposes outcome evidence in slashing scenarios — worth a cross-spec note.

✅ todos
• Address remaining CI questions on PR #20 now that the PR #21 encoding-contract dependency is cleared, and drive toward merge.
• Review the attribution ledger v2 schema as a group and confirm the surface taxonomy update is final before the proposal moves further.
• Follow up on the ERC-8183 knowledge checkpoint — determine whether the deferred item can now be closed or needs a scheduled coverage pass.

A solid day of parallel progress across three repos and two active proposals — jump in on the open PRs and the attribution ledger design before the next window 🔍
